title: Badges are vertically centered, blank on summary rows, and carry their text as the accessible label
refs: specs/sbr-sales-by-representative.md Story 8 S8-R4; S8-R5; S8-R6; Story 18 S18-R6
custom_preconds: 1. A rep is expanded with badges visible.
custom_steps:
1. Look at a badge's vertical position within its cell.
2. Read the Status cell on a rep summary row.
3. Check that the status is readable from the badge text alone (not only its color).
custom_expected:
1. The badge is vertically centered within its cell.
2. On rep summary rows the Status cell is blank.
3. The badge's text ("Paid"/"Partially Paid"/"Unpaid") is the accessible label — status is never conveyed by color alone.
